pitchSubject: Your site is fine — your phone number is the problem
pitchEmail:
Hi Dr. Vincent,

Tyler McManus here — thanks for the email address earlier.

First, the honest part: your site is not broken. It works on a phone, it is secure, and it loads quickly. I am not going to tell you otherwise.

What I did find is smaller and more specific.

Your phone number is not tappable. Somebody with a cracked tooth, on their phone, has to copy it out by hand instead of pressing it. For a dental practice that is the whole point of the page.

Your site also has no page title or description, and no Google business markup — which is the bit that tells Google your hours, your address and your phone. Right now Google has to guess, and the copyright on the page still says 2012.

Attached is a version with those fixed. Open it on your phone. It is 38KB, loads instantly, and the number is tappable everywhere.

$750 to put it on your domain, live in 5 business days. $60/month after that if you want me hosting it and making changes — cancel any time. If you don't like it, you don't pay, and you keep the file either way.

One thing I would need from you before it went live: your real service list and a few reviews from patients. I have not invented either, so the page is honest but thin until you fill those in.

Tyler McManus
McManus Web Co.
302-649-6600
